description:
[Reports] List what a custom report can use on this account: datasets (interview results, invitations, position pipeline, ATS pipeline, credits, coaching sessions - only those the account and your role include), their dimensions (group by / conditions, with allowed values) and measures. Call this first: a report definition may only use ids listed here. Custom reports are switched on per account by JobMojito; while they are off, every report tool is refused with 403 'Custom reports are not enabled for this account.' Tell the user to contact JobMojito rather than retrying.

Every argument in full, with examples: get_tool_reference.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

dataset.description: Only this dataset (e.g. positions, interview_results); the other keys are returned as usual.

llm_model.description: Your model id, e.g. "claude-opus-4-8"; "unknown" if unsure. For analytics.

merchant_id.description: Optional merchant to scope to. Admins and sub-merchant operators only; other callers always use their token's merchant.

name: list_report_fields
title: List report datasets and fields
